title: Convert to scientific notation
text: Before calculating the time, use your calculator to find $${26}^8$$, $$then$$ $$write$$ $$it$$ $$in$$ $$scientific$$ $$notation$$ $$rounded$$ $$to$$ $$one$$ $$decimal$$ $$place$$ $$(e.g.$$, $$a.b\times10**c$$ ).

subHints.title: Calculator output
subHints.text: Your calculator will show something like 208,827,064,576.

subHints.title: Move the decimal
subHints.text: To write this in scientific notation, move the decimal point $$11$$ spaces to the left to get a number between $$1$$ and $$10$$. This gives approximately $$2.1\times10**{11}.$$

title: Divide by one million
text: One million is $${10}^6$$ so checking $$2.1\times10**{11}$$ passwords at $${10}^6$$ passwords per second gives $$(2.1\times10**{11})/(10**6) $$=$$ $$2.1$$ $$\cdot$$ $${10}^5$$ seconds.

title: Convert seconds to hours
text: There are $$3600={60}^2$$ seconds per hour, so $$(2.1\times10**5)/3600=58.33$$ hours. Rounding to the nearest whole hour gives $$58$$.
